about_the_game:
Play a delightfully stinky Goblin! 

Go goblin mode and become the goblin chef you were always meant to be. Live in your swamp, hunt, be green and smelly with a love for all things gross! It's great for a goblin!

Forage for bugs and plants

Take to the bog, scour the swamp water or explore the forests in search for the worst (best) nastiest ingredients like bugs and putrid plants to make your goblin dishes.

Create stews, preserves and ghastly dishes fit for Goblin kind

Bring home the icky goods back to your humble hut. There you can use the cauldron, jars and bottles to create a variety of dishes fit for Goblin Royalty!

Wow the Goblin Royalty for coin

Bring your best preserves and meals to the Goblin Court at the end of 5 days (Goblins can't count past that you know). Wow them at the warty banquet for coin and prestige.

Upgrade your kitchen

Use the coin earned and buy upgrades from the local Bog Goblin to make bigger, grosser and better food!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 3.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce 10 Series or AMD Radeon RX 500 Series
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Welcome to the swamp! In Goblin Gourmet you'll take on the role of a goblin chef. Forage for bugs, plants and anything wonderfully gross to create dishes, preserves and stews to impress all at the goblin banquet! Get cozy, get gross, go Goblin mode!
